title: Use a joint-source Stein gauge for a bounded initial analytical inverse
statement: Every symmetric Gaussian Frobenius-L2 field R(G,Z) has a centered u and joint kernel(JG,JZ) with delta_GJG+delta_ZJZ=u,JG=-D_Gu,sym[JZ+(D_Zu)^T]=-R,||Du||_2<=||R||_2,||D_Gu||_2<=||R||_2/2,||J||_2<=sqrt(3)||R||_2. The stated uniform operator-coefficient gate theta<1 gives a full initial Neumann inverse; raw conservative Lip(h)=lambda<1 at h(G)+Z satisfies theta<=lambda.

requires: Joint Gaussian Sobolev fields and true Stein identities
Uniform L-infinity operator bounds on K-H,A-I,C-I for the perturbed inverse
provides: Removes initial analytical source-derivative loss by enlarging the kernel class
Independent eta reserve converts that L1 receipt into full TV with factor log(1+eta^(-2))/sqrt(2)
assumptions: Only JOINT divergence closure in L2; separate divergence domains need not be L2
Consistent with the strict-noise-only inverse obstruction, which uses another kernel class
L2 products need not be L2; next residual/coefficient gate is not preserved
costs: h,K,Dh and Hermite/OU/Neumann fields are analysis, not acquired g values
Initial||R||_2<=lambda^2sqrt(d) gives O(d lambda^4) one-step L1 bound
contract.units: Joint Gaussian L2/W1,2 analysis, not executed query complexity
contract.obstruction: No acquired reusable quadratic compiler, every-execution polylog query theorem, universal bit bound, priority or practical advantage.

evidence.quote: two divergences separately need not be L2
evidence.range_scope: Joint-source initial inverse, joint divergence closure and L1 product boundary.

body: A true larger analytical inverse. Its source-adjoint block cannot be discarded; acquisition and repeated norm closure remain open.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
